meta.title: How a bond lives on Qupon

hero.lead1: A bond is a sequence of dated events. This page follows one coupon from announcement to payout, in plain language: the same life Qupon runs on devnet. It starts with the
hero.lead2: : the moment that decides who gets paid.
hero.railTitle: The life of QPNb1: a coupon every six months, then redemption

s1.title: 1 · The issue
s1.body: The issuer creates the series on-chain: 100 bonds of 1,000 ₸ at 10% a year, placed with three holders of 10, 25 and 65 bonds. Every holder's wallet carries a KYC attestation; the register is the token ledger itself.

s2.title: 2 · The announcement
s2.body: The registrar announces the coupon as a corporate action: the period, the record date, the payment date and 50.00 ₸ per bond. Custodians and banks get it as a seev.031 notice.

s3.title: 3 · The record date
s3.body: Whoever holds the bond at the record date is paid, even if they sell a second later. Trading never stops: each holder is copied into the on-chain snapshot before their first transfer after the record date, and the snapshot must add up to every bond outstanding.

s4.title: 4 · The escrow
s4.body: The issuer funds a program-owned escrow with the full amount: 5,000 ₸ for this coupon. From then on nobody can redirect the money: it can only reach the snapshotted holders, the tax vault or the paying agent.

s5.title: 5 · The payout
s5.body: Any wallet can push the payout: the step is permissionless, so a funded coupon cannot be stalled. Wallet holders receive tKZT directly; bank-routed holders are paid through the paying agent (the bank transfer is simulated). Each holder gets a seev.036 confirmation.

s6.title: 6 · Default, cure, redemption
s6.body: If the escrow is still short one grace day after the payment date, anyone can record the default on-chain. The issuer cures it by funding late, and the money still goes to the record-date holders. At maturity the principal is paid and the bonds are burned in one instruction.

money.lead: The example coupon: 100 bonds × 50.00 ₸ = 5,000 ₸ from the escrow to three holders: 500, 1,250 and 3,250 ₸.

plan15.title: Six mechanics under the hood
plan15.lead: What Qupon adds to a plain tokenized bond. Every card links a real transaction from the plan-15 devnet run.

register.title: The register never pauses
register.body: The record date is not a freeze. The bond's transfer hook lets every trade through, but from the record moment it copies the seller into the on-chain snapshot first, so trading never stops for a coupon. Once the snapshot is final the gate disarms and buyers trade ex-coupon: the seller keeps this payout.
register.l2: Record date: the hook gates each trade

crank.title: Anyone can push the next step
crank.body: Snapshotting, payout and completion are permissionless: any wallet can push them and the program checks every rule, so a funded coupon cannot be stalled by an absent operator. Each step is its own transaction, visible to everyone.

late.title: When the issuer is late
late.body: If the escrow is still short one series day after the payment date, anyone can record the default on-chain: it becomes part of the series' public history and no new action opens while it stands. The issuer cures it simply by funding the escrow — and the record-date holders are paid all the same.

bank.title: Paid to your bank
bank.body: Each holder chooses their own payout route on-chain: straight to their wallet, or through the paying agent to a bank account only that holder's signature can set. The action cannot close until the agent confirms the transfer; the bank transfer itself is simulated.
bank.l2: Coupon paid to the paying agent

anchored.title: The notice is anchored
anchored.body: The registrar's seev.031 notice is hashed with sha256 and the hash is written on-chain once, where nobody can change or reissue it. Custodians can check any copy of the file against the anchored hash at any time.

accrued.title: Buying between coupons
accrued.body: A bond sold between coupons carries its accrued interest: the buyer pays the seller the part of the next coupon already earned, on top of the clean price. After the record date this flips — the accrued amount turns negative and the seller keeps the coupon. Every admitted trade records the split on-chain.
